questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。根据上下文“As Jamaica's top goal scorer, she can easily... any boots she wants”，作为牙买加顶尖射手，她经济宽裕，可以“买得起（afford）”任何她想要的球鞋。选项A分享；B买得起，承担得起；C交换；D命令，指挥。故选B。
questions.supplement:
A(share)：语境句：Good friends always share their joys and sorrows. 固定搭配：share with, share out
B(afford)：语境句：I can't afford to buy a new car right now. 固定搭配：can afford to do, afford sth.
C(exchange)：语境句：They exchanged gifts at the Christmas party. 固定搭配：exchange A for B, in exchange for
D(command)：语境句：The officer commanded his men to shoot. 固定搭配：command sb to do, under the command of

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。结合后文“as prizes”，她把这些高质量的二手球鞋作为奖品“赠送（present）”给当地的女子足球比赛。选项A卖；B买；C要求；D颁发，赠送。故选D。
questions.supplement:
A(sells)：语境句：He sells fresh vegetables at the market. 固定搭配：sell out, sell well
B(buys)：语境句：She buys a cup of coffee every morning. 固定搭配：buy in, buy off
C(requires)：语境句：This job requires a high level of concentration. 固定搭配：require sb to do, require doing
D(presents)：语境句：The mayor presented the winner with a gold medal. 固定搭配：present sb with sth, present sth to sb

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。根据语境“in local female football competitions”，在足球比赛中，球鞋被当作“奖品（prizes）”发给女孩们。选项A奖牌；B奖品；C惩罚；D挑战。故选B。
questions.supplement:
A(medals)：语境句：She won two gold medals in the Olympic Games. 固定搭配：gold medal, award a medal
B(prizes)：语境句：He won first prize in the speech contest. 固定搭配：win a prize, first prize
C(punishments)：语境句：Capital punishment has been abolished in many countries. 固定搭配：capital punishment, escape punishment
D(challenges)：语境句：We are ready to face the new challenges ahead. 固定搭配：face a challenge, overcome a challenge

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。“Bunny”并不是她的本名（Khadija Shaw），而是她哥哥给她起的“绰号/小名（nickname）”。选项A绰号；B头衔；C荣誉；D礼物。故选A。
questions.supplement:
A(nickname)：语境句：His friends gave him the nickname 'Speedy'. 固定搭配：go by the nickname of, earn a nickname
B(title)：语境句：The book's title is very catchy. 固定搭配：job title, win the title
C(honor)：语境句：It is a great honor to be invited to speak here. 固定搭配：in honor of, do the honors
D(gift)：语境句：She has a natural gift for music. 固定搭配：birthday gift, have a gift for

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。人们会聚集在一起，对谁会赢街头足球进行“打赌（bet）”。选项A决定；B呼喊/称呼；C打赌；D坚持。bet on 为固定搭配，意为“对……下注/打赌”。
questions.supplement:
A(decided)：语境句：They finally decided to go to Paris for their holiday. 固定搭配：decide to do, decide on
B(called)：语境句：He called her name loudly across the street. 固定搭配：call off, call for
C(bet)：语境句：I bet that our team will win the championship. 固定搭配：bet on sth, make a bet
D(insisted)：语境句：She insisted on paying for the dinner. 固定搭配：insist on doing, insist that

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。Shaw是在“回忆（recalls）”她童年时的情景。选项A回忆；B确认；C承认；D宣布。故选A。
questions.supplement:
A(recalls)：语境句：The old man recalls his youth with a smile. 固定搭配：recall doing sth, beyond recall
B(confirms)：语境句：The test results confirmed the doctor's diagnosis. 固定搭配：confirm one's belief, confirm a reservation
C(admits)：语境句：He reluctantly admitted making a mistake. 固定搭配：admit doing sth, admit to
D(declares)：语境句：The government declared a state of emergency. 固定搭配：declare war, declare one's intention

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。前文提到“I wanted to be a part of that!”，所以她“加入（joined）”了他们一起踢球。选项A拒绝；B赞扬；C加入；D钦佩。故选C。
questions.supplement:
A(rejected)：语境句：The committee rejected his proposal entirely. 固定搭配：reject an offer, reject a plan
B(praised)：语境句：The teacher praised the student for his hard work. 固定搭配：praise sb for sth, sing the praises of
C(joined)：语境句：She joined the tennis club to stay fit. 固定搭配：join in, join up
D(admired)：语境句：I really admired her courage in facing the difficulty. 固定搭配：admire sb for sth, greatly admire

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。后半句提到她父母很看重教育，母亲觉得踢球浪费时间，因此对于她踢球，父母并不“高兴（delighted）”。此处是否定“weren't delighted”。选项A失望的；B烦恼的；C担忧的；D高兴的。故选D。
questions.supplement:
A(disappointed)：语境句：I was highly disappointed with the movie's ending. 固定搭配：be disappointed at/with, disappointed to see
B(annoyed)：语境句：He was annoyed by the constant noise outside. 固定搭配：be annoyed with sb, get annoyed
C(concerned)：语境句：We are deeply concerned about environmental issues. 固定搭配：be concerned about, as far as I am concerned
D(delighted)：语境句：She was delighted to receive the invitation letter. 固定搭配：be delighted to do, be delighted with

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析与固定搭配。母亲尤其认为踢球是“浪费（waste）”时间。a waste of time 是固定搭配。选项A浪费；B事情/物质；C缺乏；D标志。故选A。
questions.supplement:
A(waste)：语境句：Arguing with him is just a waste of time. 固定搭配：a waste of time/money, waste time doing sth
B(matter)：语境句：It's a matter of life and death. 固定搭配：as a matter of fact, no matter what
C(lack)：语境句：The project failed due to a lack of funds. 固定搭配：lack of, for lack of
D(sign)：语境句：A sudden drop in temperature is a sign of winter. 固定搭配：sign of, warning sign

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。根据上下文，Shaw渴望踢球，梦想着在世界上最伟大的足球“锦标赛/赛事（tournament）”中竞争（即世界杯）。选项A典礼；B锦标赛；C体育馆；D练习。故选B。
questions.supplement:
A(ceremony)：语境句：The opening ceremony of the Olympics was spectacular. 固定搭配：wedding ceremony, award ceremony
B(tournament)：语境句：She won the grand slam tennis tournament last year. 固定搭配：tennis tournament, golf tournament
C(gym)：语境句：He goes to the gym every evening to work out. 固定搭配：hit the gym, gym class
D(practice)：语境句：Practice makes perfect. 固定搭配：in practice, out of practice

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。直到14岁时她被“选拔/挑选（selected）”进入牙买加U15国家队。选项A移除；B采纳/收养；C选择/选拔；D欣赏/感激。故选C。
questions.supplement:
A(removed)：语境句：The stain on the shirt was easily removed. 固定搭配：remove from, completely remove
B(adopted)：语境句：The couple adopted an orphan from the local shelter. 固定搭配：adopt a policy, adopt a child
C(selected)：语境句：She was selected to represent her school in the debate. 固定搭配：be selected for, carefully selected
D(appreciated)：语境句：I really appreciated your help when I was in trouble. 固定搭配：highly appreciate, appreciate doing sth

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。父亲“说服（convinced）”了Bunny的母亲，这这对女儿来说将是宝贵的经历。选项A说服；B命令；C询问；D强迫。故选A。
questions.supplement:
A(convinced)：语境句：He finally convinced the jury of his innocence. 固定搭配：convince sb of sth, convince sb to do
B(ordered)：语境句：The general ordered his troops to advance. 固定搭配：in order to, out of order
C(inquired)：语境句：She inquired about the flight schedule at the desk. 固定搭配：inquire about, inquire into
D(forced)：语境句：He was forced to resign due to health problems. 固定搭配：force sb to do, by force

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析与搭配。牙买加国家队击败巴拿马后，“获得了（qualified）”2019女足世界杯的参赛资格。qualify for 为固定搭配，意为“取得……的资格”。
questions.supplement:
A(applied)：语境句：He applied for a scholarship to study abroad. 固定搭配：apply for, apply to
B(qualified)：语境句：She is highly qualified for the teaching position. 固定搭配：qualify for, be qualified to do
C(prepared)：语境句：They are fully prepared for the upcoming exam. 固定搭配：prepare for, be well prepared
D(trained)：语境句：The dogs are specifically trained to detect drugs. 固定搭配：train for, trained professional

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。上文提到了她“dreamed of competing in the sport's greatest...”，此处呼应，她的“梦想（dream）”实现了。选项A信念；B比赛；C成功；D梦想。故选D。
questions.supplement:
A(belief)：语境句：His strong belief in justice guided his actions. 固定搭配：beyond belief, firm belief
B(game)：语境句：Let's play a game of chess. 固定搭配：play a game, video game
C(success)：语境句：Hard work is the key to success. 固定搭配：achieve success, great success
D(dream)：语境句：Her childhood dream finally came true. 固定搭配：realize a dream, dream of

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。当我“回顾（look back on）”过去和现在的处境时，我为自己感到骄傲。选项A尊敬；B期待；C回顾；D当心/寻找。故选C。
questions.supplement:
A(look up to)：语境句：Many young people look up to him as a role model. 固定搭配：look up to sb
B(look forward to)：语境句：I sincerely look forward to hearing from you soon. 固定搭配：look forward to doing sth
C(look back on)：语境句：Looking back on my college years, I have no regrets. 固定搭配：look back on the past
D(look out for)：语境句：Please look out for cars when you cross the street. 固定搭配：look out for sb/sth

vocab_pack.definition_en: the player who has scored the most goals in a competition or team
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作表语，前面有as引导，表示作为牙买加最佳射手
vocab_pack.example_en: As the top goal scorer, she leads the team in points.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 作为最佳射手，她在得分上领先全队。

vocab_pack.definition_en: have enough money to buy or do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 与情态动词can连用，表示有能力负担；句中can afford是情态动词加动词原形
vocab_pack.example_en: He cannot afford to buy a new car this year.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他今年买不起新车。
vocab_pack.from_passage: she can easily afford any boots she wants

vocab_pack.definition_en: give something formally to someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般现在时第三人称单数形式presents，后接双宾语：presents those boots as prizes
vocab_pack.example_en: The principal will present the award to the winner.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 校长将向获胜者颁发奖项。
vocab_pack.from_passage: she presents those top-quality secondhand boots as prizes

vocab_pack.definition_en: previously owned by someone else; not new
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作定语修饰boots，表示二手的高质量靴子
vocab_pack.example_en: She bought a secondhand bicycle from the market.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她从市场买了一辆二手自行车。

vocab_pack.definition_en: an event in which people compete to win
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为复数形式competitions，与local female football搭配，表示当地的女子足球比赛
vocab_pack.example_en: The competition was fierce among the players.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 选手之间的竞争非常激烈。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a familiar or humorous name given to someone instead of their real name
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作宾语，与as her nickname搭配，used 'Bunny' as her nickname
vocab_pack.example_en: His classmates gave him the nickname 'Flash'.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的同学给他起了个绰号叫'闪电'。

vocab_pack.definition_en: come together in a group
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中与would连用，表示过去经常发生的行为：A lot of people would gather
vocab_pack.example_en: Fans gather outside the stadium to cheer for the team.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 球迷们聚集在体育场外为球队加油。
vocab_pack.from_passage: A lot of people would gather and bet

vocab_pack.definition_en: risk money on the result of an event
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中与would连用，过去习惯：would bet on who was going to win
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people bet on the outcome of the match.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 很多人对比赛结果下注。
vocab_pack.from_passage: bet on who was going to win

vocab_pack.definition_en: an activity that is useless or a bad use of time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作表语，前面有was：thought football was a waste of time
vocab_pack.example_en: He considers playing video games a waste of time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他认为玩电子游戏是浪费时间。
vocab_pack.from_passage: thought football was a waste of time

vocab_pack.definition_en: imagine or hope for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为过去式dreamed of，后接动名词短语competing in...，表示梦想参加比赛
vocab_pack.example_en: She dreams of becoming a professional singer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她梦想成为一名专业歌手。
vocab_pack.from_passage: who dreamed of competing in the sport's greatest tournament

vocab_pack.definition_en: take part in a competition or event
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为动名词形式competing in，作介词of的宾语，与dreamed of连用
vocab_pack.example_en: Athletes from all over the world compete in the Olympics.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 来自世界各地的运动员参加奥运会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: competing in the sport's greatest tournament

vocab_pack.definition_en: a series of contests in a sport, with a winner at the end
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作名词，the sport's greatest tournament指体育界最重大的锦标赛（世界杯）
vocab_pack.example_en: The tennis tournament attracts many top players.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这项网球锦标赛吸引了许多顶级选手。

vocab_pack.definition_en: choose someone or something from a group
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为被动语态was selected，过去分词，后面接at age 14 for the team
vocab_pack.example_en: He was selected for the national team after his excellent performance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他因表现出色被选入国家队。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was selected at age 14 for the Jamaica Under 15s football team

vocab_pack.definition_en: cause someone to believe or agree to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为过去式convinced，后接宾语Bunny's mother和that从句
vocab_pack.example_en: I convinced my friend to join the club.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我说服了我的朋友加入俱乐部。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Her father convinced Bunny's mother that it would be a valuable experience

vocab_pack.definition_en: an experience that is very useful or important
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作表语，前面有would be a valuable experience
vocab_pack.example_en: Working abroad was a valuable experience for him.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在国外工作对他来说是一次宝贵的经历。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it would be a valuable experience for their daughter

vocab_pack.definition_en: in the process of achieving something; started
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 在...的路上（喻指成功或进步）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为on her way，独立成句表示她开始走上成功之路
vocab_pack.example_en: After winning the scholarship, she was on her way to a great future.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 获得奖学金后，她正走向光明的未来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Bunny Shaw was on her way.

vocab_pack.definition_en: be selected to become a member of the national team
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为过去式made，后接名词短语the national team，表示成功入选
vocab_pack.example_en: He worked hard and finally made the national team.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他努力训练，最终入选了国家队。
vocab_pack.from_passage: She made the national team in 2015.

vocab_pack.definition_en: become eligible or achieve the required standard to enter a competition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为过去式qualified for，后接the 2019 Women's World Cup
vocab_pack.example_en: The team qualified for the finals after a tough match.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 球队在一场艰苦的比赛后晋级了决赛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the Jamaican national team qualified for the 2019 Women's World Cup

vocab_pack.definition_en: defeat someone in a game or competition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为现在分词beating，引导状语，表示在击败巴拿马之后
vocab_pack.example_en: Our team beat the opponents by three goals.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们队以三球击败对手。

vocab_pack.definition_en: achieve something one has hoped for
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为被动语态was realized，主语是Shaw's dream，表示梦想被实现
vocab_pack.example_en: She finally realized her dream of becoming a doctor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她最终实现了成为医生的梦想。

vocab_pack.definition_en: think about something from the past
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为动词原形，与when I look back on连用，后接where I was then
vocab_pack.example_en: When I look back on my college days, I feel grateful.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当我回顾大学时光，我感到感激。
vocab_pack.from_passage: When I look back on where I was then and where I am now

vocab_pack.definition_en: feel satisfaction and pleasure because of something one has done
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中省略了be动词am，完整应为I am proud of myself
vocab_pack.example_en: She is proud of her achievements.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她为自己的成就感到骄傲。

vocab_pack.definition_en: employ something for a particular purpose or role
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为过去式used，后接Bunny as her nickname，表示使用Bunny作为昵称
vocab_pack.example_en: They used the old building as a community center.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们把这栋旧建筑用作社区中心。

vocab_pack.definition_en: consider something to be important
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为过去式valued，后接their kids' education，表示非常重视孩子的教育
vocab_pack.example_en: She values honesty above all else.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她看重诚实胜过一切。
vocab_pack.from_passage: who valued their kids' education very much

vocab_pack.definition_en: especially, specifically
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作状语，修饰her mother，强调母亲尤其这样认为
vocab_pack.example_en: I like all fruits, but apples in particular.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我喜欢所有水果，尤其是苹果。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Her mother in particular thought football was a waste of time.

vocab_pack.definition_en: be away from home or not in usual place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为过去式was out，表示母亲不在家的时候
vocab_pack.example_en: She was out when I called her.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我打电话时她出去了。

vocab_pack.definition_en: at the age of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中at age 14作时间状语，表示在14岁时被选中
vocab_pack.example_en: He started learning piano at age five.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他五岁时开始学钢琴。

vocab_pack.definition_en: be included or involved in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为不定式to be a part of that，表示想参与其中
vocab_pack.example_en: She wants to be a part of the community project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她想参与社区项目。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I wanted to be a part of that!

vocab_pack.definition_en: superlative of great; most important or best
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为形容词最高级，修饰tournament
vocab_pack.example_en: This is the greatest victory of her career.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这是她职业生涯中最伟大的胜利。

vocab_pack.definition_en: of the highest quality
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作定语，修饰secondhand boots，表示高质量的二手靴子
vocab_pack.example_en: We only use top-quality materials for our products.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们只使用最高质量的材料来生产产品。

section_2_word_form.passage:
African History
Africans are the most diverse people in the world. Perhaps this has a connection with the fact that they are the earliest humans, [56] it has been proved that humans adapt [57] the different environments they find themselves in over time as they migrate.
Before the arrival of the Europeans, Africans had already travelled to other parts of the world in [58] "human migration" waves, and many findings give us an insight into the way of life of much earlier societies.
Ancient Africans were pioneers of early civilization, [59] can be proved with the evidence that early African societies excelled in fields such as engineering, mathematics, writing and navigation.
Some great African civilizations such as the Benin Empire, Ancient Egypt, had a highly [60] society, which was developed, [61] out in trade and grew stronger in culture.
Sadly, Africa's [62], which parallel global developments, are often undercredited.
The abundance of the rich natural resources of Africa soon led to avarice (贪婪) on the part of the Europeans, [63] in a mad scramble for Africa's resources, including its people. Between 11 and 15 million Africans [64] overseas and sold into slavery. Over the years, the wars had been a complex and complicated problem.
Today, most of the conflicts have ceased. The continent is gradually taking [65] place in the committee of nations.

questions.explanation: 本题考查连词。前后句为因果关系：人类经过迁徙随着时间推移会适应环境，【因为】他们是最早的人类（有足够时间迁徙演变），所以非洲人是最多样化的。此处填 as, since 或 because 引导原因状语从句均可。
questions.supplement: 正确形(as/since/because)：语境句：I decided to stay at home as/since/because it was raining heavily. 固定搭配：because of, ever since。其它连词用法：and(并列), but(转折)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查介词。adapt to 是固定搭配，意为“适应……”，此处理解为“适应他们所处的不同环境”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to)：语境句：It took him a while to adapt to the new working environment. 固定搭配：adapt to, contribute to。原词adapt其它变形：adaptation(n.), adaptable(adj.).

questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换。修饰名词短语 "human migration" waves 需要用形容词形式，variety 的形容词形式为 various，意为“各种各样的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(various)：语境句：The school offers a variety of clubs, attracting students with various interests. 固定搭配：various kinds of, for various reasons。原词variety其它变形：vary(v.), variable(adj./n.).

questions.explanation: 本题考查非限制性定语从句。逗号后引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面的整句话“Ancient Africans were pioneers of early civilization”，在从句中作主语，因此填关系代词 which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：He passed the exam, which made his parents very happy. 固定搭配：in which, from which。

questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换。修饰名词 society，且由 highly 修饰，此处需要用过去分词转化为形容词的 organized，意为“高度有组织的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(organized)：语境句：He is a highly organized person who plans everything in advance. 固定搭配：well organized, highly organized。原词organize其它变形：organization(n.), organizer(n.), disorganized(adj.).

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词时态与平行结构。此处 stood out 与前面的 was developed 以及后面的 grew stronger 并列，作定语从句的谓语动词，讲述过去的史实，故用一般过去时 stood。
questions.supplement: 正确形(stood)：语境句：Her bright red dress stood out in the crowd. 固定搭配：stand out, stand for, stand by。原词stand其它变形：standing(n./adj.), outstanding(adj.).

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词单复数。谓语动词为 are，可知主语应为复数名词，contribute 的名词形式为 contribution，故填 contributions，意为“贡献”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(contributions)：语境句：Marie Curie made great contributions to the field of science. 固定搭配：make contributions to, contribute to。原词contribute其它变形：contributor(n.), contributory(adj.).

questions.explanation: 本题考查非谓语动词。欧洲人的贪婪导致了疯狂的资源抢夺。此处作自然而然的结果状语，动词 result 与逻辑主语 avarice/前面的事情呈主动关系，故用现在分词 resulting (in)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(resulting)：语境句：The heavy rain lasted for days, resulting in severe floods. 固定搭配：result in, result from。原词result其它常见用法：as a result, as a result of。

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词时态和语态。主语 Africans 与动词 ship 之间为被动关系（被运送），且讲述的是过去的客观历史事实，故使用一般过去时的被动语态 were shipped。
questions.supplement: 正确形(were shipped)：语境句：The urgent medical supplies were shipped to the disaster area yesterday. 固定搭配：ship out, ship to。原词ship其它变形：shipment(n.), shipping(n.).

questions.explanation: 本题考查代词。指代前文的“The continent（非洲大陆）”，在名词 place 前作定语，表示“它的”，应使用形容词性物主代词 its（逐渐在国际委员会中占据其位置）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(its)：语境句：The company has successfully expanded its business to overseas markets. 固定搭配：its own, on its own, take its place。

vocab_pack.definition_en: showing a great deal of variety; very different
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词最高级形式，most diverse 作表语，描述主语 Africans。
vocab_pack.example_en: The city has a diverse population with many ethnic groups.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个城市拥有多元化的族群人口。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Africans are the most diverse people in the world.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be related or linked to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，has 是第三人称单数一般现在时，与主语 this 搭配，表示“与……有联系”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her success has a connection with her hard work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的成功与她的努力有关。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has a connection with the fact

vocab_pack.definition_en: to adjust to new conditions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时第三人称复数，adapt 作谓语，to 是介词，后接名词短语 the different environments。
vocab_pack.example_en: Animals must adapt to changing environments to survive.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 动物必须适应不断变化的环境才能生存。
vocab_pack.from_passage: humans adapt to the different environments

vocab_pack.definition_en: to realize that one is in a particular situation, often unexpectedly
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 发现自己处于（某种情况）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，find 动词原形，themselves 是反身代词复数，与主语 humans 对应，in 后接地点或处境。
vocab_pack.example_en: He found himself in a difficult situation after the accident.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 事故后他发现自己处于困境。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move from one region to another, especially seasonally or for settlement
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时第三人称复数，migrate 作谓语，as 引导时间状语从句，表示“当他们迁徙时”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many birds migrate south for the winter.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多鸟类冬季向南迁徙。

vocab_pack.definition_en: prior to someone or something coming
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作时间状语，arrival 是名词，of 后接名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Before the arrival of the train, we had a cup of coffee.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 火车到来之前我们喝了杯咖啡。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Before the arrival of the Europeans

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make a journey, especially a long one
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去完成时，had travelled 表示在某个过去时间点之前已经完成的动作。travelled 是过去分词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She had travelled across Asia before she turned thirty.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在三十岁前已游历了亚洲。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the movement of people from one place to another, especially in large groups
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词 in 的宾语，waves 是后面名词，形成“in various... waves”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Human migration has shaped the genetic diversity of populations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 人类迁徙塑造了种群的遗传多样性。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to provide a deep understanding of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，give 是谓语动词原形（主语 findings 复数），us 是间接宾语，an insight into 是直接宾语部分。
vocab_pack.example_en: This documentary gives an insight into the lives of penguins.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部纪录片让人深入了解企鹅的生活。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the typical manner in which a person or group lives
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词 into 的宾语，in the way of life of... 表示“对……生活方式的了解”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The nomadic way of life is disappearing in many parts of the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 游牧生活方式在世界许多地方正在消失。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who is among the first to explore or settle a new area or develop a new field
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词复数作表语，were pioneers 表示“是先驱”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Marie Curie was a pioneer in the field of radioactivity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 居里夫人是放射学领域的先驱。

vocab_pack.definition_en: being among the first in a particular field or domain
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词复数 pioneers 后接 of 短语作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is considered a pioneer of modern medicine.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他被认为是现代医学的先驱。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be exceptionally good at or proficient in an activity or subject
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，excelled 是过去式，主语 early African societies，后接 in 短语表示领域。
vocab_pack.example_en: She excelled in mathematics throughout her school years.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她整个学生时代在数学方面都很出色。

vocab_pack.definition_en: very well-structured and arranged
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词短语作定语修饰 society，highly 是副词修饰 organized（过去分词作形容词）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company has a highly organized management system.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家公司有高度组织化的管理系统。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be noticeable or prominent in a particular area
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，stood 是过去式，out 是副词，in 是介词，后接 trade。
vocab_pack.example_en: This restaurant stands out in the neighborhood for its excellent service.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家餐厅因其优质服务在附近脱颖而出。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become more powerful or influential in a particular aspect
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，grew 是过去式，stronger 是形容词比较级作表语，in 后接 culture。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company grew stronger in the Asian market over the decade.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那十年里这家公司在亚洲市场变得更强。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to correspond to or be similar to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，parallel 是动词原形，主语 which（指代 Africa's contributions），宾语 global developments。
vocab_pack.example_en: The rise in sea levels parallels the increase in global temperatures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 海平面上升与全球气温升高相对应。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give insufficient credit or recognition to someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时被动语态，are undercredited 表示“常常被低估”，undercredited 是过去分词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The contributions of many women scientists have been undercredited in history.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多女科学家的贡献在历史上被低估了。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a very large quantity of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作主语，The abundance of... 表示“……的丰富”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The region has an abundance of natural resources.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该地区拥有丰富的自然资源。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The abundance of the rich natural resources

vocab_pack.definition_en: plentiful natural assets such as minerals, forests, water, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，rich 是形容词修饰 natural resources，作介词 of 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Countries with rich natural resources can develop their economies quickly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 拥有丰富自然资源的国家可以快速发展经济。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause something to happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，led 是过去式，主语 abundance，后接名词短语 avarice。
vocab_pack.example_en: Poor management led to the company's bankruptcy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 管理不善导致了公司破产。

vocab_pack.definition_en: extreme greed for wealth or material gain
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作宾语，led to avarice 表示“导致了贪婪”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The avarice of some corporations has caused environmental damage.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一些公司的贪婪已造成环境破坏。

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to indicate who is doing something or who is responsible for an action
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作定语或状语，这里修饰 avarice，表示“欧洲人的贪婪”。
vocab_pack.example_en: There was a lack of cooperation on the part of the employees.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 员工方面缺乏合作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: on the part of the Europeans

vocab_pack.definition_en: a frantic and disorderly rush or competition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，resulting in a mad scramble for... 是结果状语，scramble 是名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: There was a mad scramble for tickets when the concert was announced.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 音乐会宣布后出现了一场门票抢购狂潮。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a mad scramble for Africa's resources

vocab_pack.definition_en: to transport goods or people by ship or other means
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态一般过去时，were shipped 表示“被运往”，shipped 是过去分词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The goods were shipped to Europe last week.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 货物上周被运往欧洲。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to sell someone to become a slave
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态一般过去时，were sold into slavery，sold 是过去分词，into slavery 表示结果状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many captured people were sold into slavery in ancient times.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 古代许多被俘的人被卖为奴隶。

vocab_pack.definition_en: very intricate and difficult to understand or deal with
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 并列形容词作定语修饰 problem，表示“复杂且复杂的”（注意原文中两个词连用有强调意味）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The issue is complex and complicated, requiring careful analysis.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个问题复杂而棘手，需要仔细分析。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stop or come to an end
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时，have ceased 表示“已经停止”，主语 most of the conflicts。
vocab_pack.example_en: The fighting has ceased after the peace treaty.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 和平条约后战斗已停止。

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a gradual way; slowly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词修饰动词短语 is taking，表示“逐渐地占据”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The economy is gradually recovering from the recession.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 经济正逐渐从衰退中恢复。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to assume a position or role that belongs to one
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在进行时，is taking its place，taking 是现在分词，its 对应 the continent，主语 the continent。
vocab_pack.example_en: As a new member, she is taking her place in the team.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 作为新成员，她正在团队中占据自己的位置。
vocab_pack.from_passage: taking its place in the committee of nations

vocab_pack.definition_en: a group of countries acting together for a common purpose; often refers to the international community
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 国际大家庭，国家委员会
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作介词 in 的宾语，the committee of nations 是固定说法，指国际社会。
vocab_pack.example_en: The country seeks to play a more active role in the committee of nations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该国寻求在国际大家庭中发挥更积极的作用。
